summary: v2 removes the large scenic faces but replaces them with ten near-continuous scalloped pseudo-writing lines, touching comb hatches, and broad substrate drift, so it cannot become golden.
required_changes: Stop prompt-only repetition after the same continuous-crest defect appeared twice. Replace the topology control with explicit three-fragment and one-detached-hatch zones, then erase only the ten scripted chains.
